title: Insurance Claim Services Dwelling Release — Code Holdback Cut
content:
| Depreciation withheld on the dwelling supplement approvals | Reconstruction contract status | Code holdback cut |
|---|---|---|
| above the change order charges posted on the contract | final invoiced or closed | the withheld amount above those charges |
| above the change order charges posted on the contract | substantially complete | the whole depreciation withheld on the dwelling supplement approvals |
| at or below those charges | any | nothing |
| any | any other status | nothing |

**Rule.** For the insured's dwelling release on an Insurance Claim Services file, the code holdback cut is set as follows: when the depreciation withheld on the file's dwelling supplement approvals is above the change order charges posted on the contract and the contract is final invoiced or closed, the withheld amount above those charges; when that withheld amount is above those charges and the contract is substantially complete, the whole depreciation withheld on the dwelling supplement approvals; otherwise nothing.

The withheld depreciation is read from the carrier's supplement approvals on the dwelling coverage of the claim file; the change order charges and the status are those of the Reconstruction contract.

*Hypothetical:* depreciation withheld on the dwelling supplement approvals 1350.00, change order charges 900.00. Final invoiced: cut 450.00. Substantially complete: cut 1350.00. With change order charges of 1400.00: no cut.
